vendor_comparison.rationale: Vendor B: $135,000 landed action cost plus $0 risk-adjusted residual loss (0 reserve-adjusted stockout days); 125 km from the plant in West Java; same-region sourcing; capacity sufficient; meets coverage deadline; feasible.

Vendor C: $110,000 landed action cost plus $87,500 risk-adjusted residual loss (1.25 reserve-adjusted stockout days); 420 km from the plant in Central Java; cross-region sourcing; capacity sufficient; misses coverage deadline; feasible.

Vendor A: $120,000 landed action cost plus $19,500 risk-adjusted residual loss (0.25 reserve-adjusted stockout days); 650 km from the plant in East Java; cross-region sourcing; capacity sufficient; meets coverage deadline; feasible.

Vendor D: $100,000 landed action cost plus $135,000 risk-adjusted residual loss (2.25 reserve-adjusted stockout days); 300 km from the plant in West Java; same-region sourcing; capacity sufficient; misses coverage deadline; not feasible.

chain_of_thought: Classified as weather. The disruption delay is 5 days and available stock covers 3 days. The resulting high classification is significant and requires mitigation. Matched 1 shipments and 1 open purchase orders in SAP.

Evaluated 1 BOM components using stock coverage and deterministic line-stoppage cost. Coverage is current stock (3,000) divided by daily consumption (1,000) = 3 days. A 5-day delay leaves 2 stockout days, with estimated inaction loss of $200,000 at $100,000 per day.
Compared 4 Ariba supplier quotes against the 5,000-unit requirement, delivery window, risk-adjusted stockout exposure, and total landed cost.
[SAP S/4HANA] Cost of inaction was computed from stock coverage and production-loss inputs by deterministic Python logic.
[SAP Ariba] Python evaluated 3 feasible supplier offers.
[Amazon Bedrock] Mock provider generated a deterministic explanation offline.

Vendor B is recommended: its 2-day lead time has a $135,000 risk-adjusted response cost against $200,000 cost of inaction. Its risk-adjusted total is $135,000. The best other feasible option is Vendor A at $139,500 risk-adjusted. A human must approve the draft before any SAP purchase-order execution.
